files.rules/ingest-source-never-polled.yaml:
# Stall · I-4.a/b (poller counter flat). Expected trust: trusted.
apiVersion: medic.rules/v1
kind: Rule
id: ingest.source-never-polled
title: Legacy poller for a source has stopped polling
revision: 1
engine_api: "1.0"
shapes: [start_sh, compose, helm]
fault: {class: ingest, mode: I-4, causes: [I-4.a, I-4.b]}
lane: 3
detection: absence
signals:
  polls: {sample: {signal: daemon_status.poller, key: polls, by: [source]}}
group_by: [source]
when:
  any:
    - {fn: absent_for, signal: polls, window: 30m}
    - {fn: changes, signal: polls, window: 30m, op: "==", value: 0}
for: 5m
advice:
  summary: The daemon hasn't polled this source for 30 minutes.
  fix: >-
    Restart soc-daemon after enabling or changing an integration. If polling
    doesn't resume, send this incident to DeepTempo Support.
files.rules/ingest-source-silent.yaml:
# Absence / freshness · I-1 (from E1 example 01). Expected trust: trusted.
apiVersion: medic.rules/v1
kind: Rule
id: ingest.source-silent
title: Enabled source reports healthy polls but has delivered no findings
revision: 1
fault: {class: ingest, mode: I-1, causes: [I-1.a, I-1.b, I-1.d, I-1.e, I-1.i, I-1.k]}
lane: 3
detection: absence
signals:
  enabled:      {sample: {signal: federation_sources, key: sources.enabled, by: [source]}}
  last_success: {sample: {signal: federation_sources, key: sources.last_success_at, by: [source]}}
  arrivals:     {sample: {signal: triage, key: sources.arrivals, by: [source]}}
group_by: [source]
when:
  all:
    - {fn: latest, signal: enabled, op: "==", value: true}
    - {fn: age, signal: last_success, op: "<", value: 600}
    - {fn: increase, signal: arrivals, window: {param: quiet_window}, op: "==", value: 0}
for: 15m
keep_firing_for: 30m
params:
  quiet_window: {type: duration, default: 6h, min: 1h, max: 48h}
advice:
  summary: Source is polled without errors but has sent no findings for the quiet window.
  fix: >-
    Check the source's credentials and configuration in Settings, Integrations,
    and confirm the source itself produced alerts in this period. If both are
    correct, send this incident to DeepTempo Support.
files.rules/llm-gateway-flapping.yaml:
# Flapping · L-4 (from E1 example 05). Expected trust: trusted.
apiVersion: medic.rules/v1
kind: Rule
id: llm.gateway-flapping
title: LLM gateway health keeps changing state
revision: 1
fault: {class: llm, mode: L-4, causes: [L-4.a]}
lane: 2
signals:
  gateway_ok: {sample: {signal: bifrost_health, key: ok}}
when: {fn: changes, signal: gateway_ok, window: 30m, op: ">=", value: 4}
keep_firing_for: 30m
advice:
  summary: Possible intermittent gateway or provider connectivity problem. Bifrost health changed state 4 or more times in 30 minutes.
  fix: >-
    Check network egress from the Bifrost container to the model provider and
    the provider's status page. If the provider is healthy, check the host's
    resource limits for the Bifrost container.
files.rules/llm-gateway-outage.yaml:
# Enter/recover pair · L-4 / P-4.a (#1689 core/llm/outage.py; services/daemon/processor.py:650).
# The recovery line uses the generic template "%s; recovered after %d failures",
# so matching which outage recovered needs args[0], which makes the rule untrusted.
apiVersion: medic.rules/v1
kind: Rule
id: llm.gateway-outage
title: Daemon can't connect to the LLM gateway, so AI triage is skipped
revision: 1
fault: {class: llm, mode: L-4, causes: [L-4.a]}
lane: 2
signals:
  down:
    log:
      signal: log_soc_daemon
      logger: {eq: services.daemon.processor}
      level: [ERROR]
      template: {eq: 'Failed to connect LLM gateway, AI triage is skipped until it connects: %s'}
  recovered:
    log:
      signal: log_soc_daemon
      logger: {eq: services.daemon.processor}
      level: [INFO]
      template: {eq: '%s; recovered after %d failures'}
      args: {"0": {eq: LLM gateway connected for AI triage}}
when: {fn: latch, set: down, clear: recovered}
advice:
  summary: soc-daemon can't reach the LLM gateway, so new findings are stored without AI triage.
  fix: >-
    Check that the Bifrost container is running and reachable from soc-daemon,
    and that its provider keys are valid (Settings, LLM providers).
files.rules/llm-provider-keyless-default.yaml:
# Config state · L-1.a (llm_providers). Expected trust: trusted.
apiVersion: medic.rules/v1
kind: Rule
id: llm.provider-keyless-default
title: Default LLM provider has no API key
revision: 1
fault: {class: llm, mode: L-1, causes: [L-1.a, L-1.b]}
lane: 2
signals:
  is_default: {sample: {signal: llm_providers, key: providers.is_default, by: [provider]}}
  has_key:    {sample: {signal: llm_providers, key: providers.has_api_key, by: [provider]}}
  is_active:  {sample: {signal: llm_providers, key: providers.is_active, by: [provider]}}
group_by: [provider]
when:
  all:
    - {fn: latest, signal: is_default, op: "==", value: true}
    - {fn: latest, signal: is_active, op: "==", value: true}
    - {fn: latest, signal: has_key, op: "==", value: false}
for: 5m
advice:
  summary: The default LLM provider is active but has no API key, so chat and triage calls will fail.
  fix: >-
    Open Settings, LLM providers. Add an API key to the default provider, or make
    a provider that has a key the default.
files.rules/pipeline-probe-missed.yaml:
# Known-answer probe outcome (enum) · P-4 end to end (D1 probe_findings). Expected trust: trusted.
apiVersion: medic.rules/v1
kind: Rule
id: pipeline.probe-missed
title: Daily known-answer probe was missed or went silent
revision: 1
fault: {class: pipeline, mode: P-4, causes: [P-4.a, P-4.b]}
lane: 3
signals:
  outcome: {sample: {signal: probe_findings, key: latest_outcome, by: [probe]}}
group_by: [probe]
when:
  any:
    - {fn: latest, signal: outcome, op: "==", value: miss}
    - {fn: latest, signal: outcome, op: "==", value: silent}
keep_firing_for: 24h
advice:
  summary: A known-answer test finding was injected but Vigil didn't detect or triage it as expected.
  fix: >-
    Send this incident to DeepTempo Support with the evidence report. The probe
    checks the whole path from ingestion to triage.
files.rules/pipeline-run-stale.yaml:
# Row age · P-2 (sql view). Expected trust: trusted.
apiVersion: medic.rules/v1
kind: Rule
id: pipeline.run-stale
title: Investigation runs are executing with no recent activity
revision: 1
fault: {class: pipeline, mode: P-2, causes: [P-2.a, P-2.b]}
lane: 3
signals:
  stale_count: {sample: {signal: sql_investigations_stale, key: stale_executing}}
  oldest:      {sample: {signal: sql_investigations_stale, key: oldest_last_activity_at}}
when:
  all:
    - {fn: latest, signal: stale_count, op: ">", value: 0}
    - {fn: age, signal: oldest, op: ">", value: 1800}
for: 10m
keep_firing_for: 30m
advice:
  summary: At least one investigation has been executing with no activity for over 30 minutes.
  fix: >-
    Send this incident to DeepTempo Support. Cancelling the stuck run in the
    console frees its slot; record that you did so.
files.rules/pipeline-triage-stalled.yaml:
# Counters compared · P-4 (D1: processed rising while triaged flat). Expected trust: trusted.
apiVersion: medic.rules/v1
kind: Rule
id: pipeline.triage-stalled
title: Findings are processed but none are triaged
revision: 1
fault: {class: pipeline, mode: P-4, causes: [P-4.a, P-4.b, P-4.c]}
lane: 3
detection: absence
signals:
  processed: {sample: {signal: daemon_status.processor, key: processed}}
  triaged:   {sample: {signal: daemon_status.processor, key: triaged}}
when:
  all:
    - {fn: increase, signal: processed, window: 30m, op: ">=", value: {param: min_processed}}
    - {fn: increase, signal: triaged, window: 30m, op: "==", value: 0}
for: 10m
keep_firing_for: 30m
params:
  min_processed: {type: number, default: 5, min: 1, max: 1000}
advice:
  summary: Findings are being stored, but AI triage has completed none in 30 minutes.
  fix: >-
    Check the LLM path (Settings, LLM providers and the Bifrost gateway). If the
    LLM path is healthy, send this incident to DeepTempo Support.
files.runbooks/restart-soc-daemon.yaml:
apiVersion: medic.runbooks/v1
kind: Runbook
id: restart-soc-daemon
title: Restart the soc-daemon container
applies_to: [pipeline.daemon-processor-restart]
action: {type: restart_service, target: soc-daemon}
verify_after_s: 900
description: >-
  Restart soc-daemon so its processor task starts again. Verify that the
  processed counter moves within 15 minutes. Phase 0 records this as
  "would have"; nothing is executed.
